
DESCRIPTION
Update One CLI to the latest stable release

USAGE
  one upgrade [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one upgrade
  one upgrade -o json

TIPS
Check for the latest stable One CLI release and update the current executable.
Downloads are verified with SHA256 and a version check. An equal or newer
installed version is kept.

Manual updates check immediately, including in CI and JSON/YAML output.
Only official stable release builds can upgrade. On Windows, the verified
update is installed after this command exits.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
